summary.objective: Repair SC5 timing detector selectivity — reduce false triggers on no-corridor (NC) trajectories while maintaining coverage on teacher-valid (TV) trajectories.
summary.outcome: V2 seed42: Primary-dev TV recall 35/36 (0.972), NC abstain 14/14 (1.000). V1 baseline: TV 35/36, NC 10/14 (4 false triggers). V2 eliminates all 4 V1 false triggers with no TV regression on Primary dev.
summary.key_tradeoff: 15/35 V2 TV triggers occur 1-3 steps before teacher anchor (V1: 0/35). This is either benign early recognition or premature triggering — requires Phase 6B state audit.
summary.held_out_nc: Diagnostic 300 (all NC): both V1 and V2 have 0 false triggers. 300 unique cells across 10 tasks, 8 perturbation templates.

FORMAL_DEV_EVALUATION_V3.evidence: V3 evaluator with original step_idx, slice-scoped metrics

DIAGNOSTIC_300_NC.evidence: 0/300 false triggers for both V1 and V2

EVIDENCE_CLEANUP.evidence: 10 files cleaned of SSH warnings, 67 JSONs validated

EARLY_EMISSION_STATE_AUDIT.description: Audit 15 early-emission TV trajectories at privileged state level. Classify each as benign early recognition (A) or premature trigger (B). Gate: max offset 3, 0 grasp-invalid emits, >= 12/15 benign.

RAW_VS_CLAMPED_ATTACK_PILOT.description: Run 4-condition paired attack trials (Clean / V1-Timing / V2-Raw / V2-Clamped) on the 15 early-emission trajectories. Gate: V2-Raw vs V2-Clamped attack success delta <= 10pp, same failure mechanism.

DATA_ABLATION.description: Train M1 (Primary 250 only) and M1-OS (Primary 250 oversampled NC) with same seeds/architecture/release-injection. Compare M2-M1 (Reserve value), M1-OS-M1 (oversampling value), M2-M1-OS (diversity value).

RELEASE_TRAJECTORY_COUNTERFACTUAL.description: Run V2 phase+corridor with hybrid release vs full V1 release path. Gate: emit disagreement <= 1/90.

FORMAL_ATTACK_BENCHMARK.description: 50-100 TV trajectories with paired Clean/Attacked rollout. Core metric: Selective Attack Success = Clean success AND Attacked failure.

HELD_OUT_TV.description: Collect held-out TV trajectories for generalization test. States 38-49 reserved for Blind-v2. May use states 28-37 with pre-registered diagnostic-only manifest.

CROSS_SUITE_ZERO_SHOT.description: Zero-shot evaluation on LIBERO-Spatial, Goal, 10. No training, no threshold tuning.

timing_concern_detail.v1_baseline: 0 early emissions — all 35 V1 triggers inside corridor

next_immediate_action: Phase 6B — Build and run early-emission state audit on the 15 trajectories identified above. Requires privileged MuJoCo state at emit_step vs anchor step.
